{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk blouse with a relaxed but structured collar, slightly dropped shoulders and a mid-length hem in a deep emerald green (#046307).
Worn over high-waisted wool crepe trousers with a tapered leg and subtle pleats at the waist in a charcoal heather (#3d3c42).
Polished leather ankle boots with a low stacked heel in a dark burgundy to echo the blouse accent (#581515).
This outfit works perfectly for a Saturday evening birthday celebration by balancing refined tailoring with autumnal richness, meeting the requested smart dress code without feeling too rigid for a party. The emerald and charcoal palette creates a sophisticated contrast that feels celebratory yet appropriate for artificial indoor lighting, while the relaxed collar adds a touch of ease suitable for an evening out with friends."}
